description: This file contains utility functions for managing secrets, including retrieving secrets from environment variables, external secret managers, and various OIDC providers. It includes functions for converting string values to boolean and fetching secrets with different fallback behaviors.

methods.name: Optional[bool] str_to_bool(value: Optional[str])
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean if it's a recognized boolean string. Returns None if the string is not a recognized boolean value.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_secret_str( secret_name: str, default_value: Optional[Union[str, bool]] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a secret and guarantees the response is a string or None.

methods.name: Optional[bool] get_secret_bool( secret_name: str, default_value: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a secret and guarantees the response is a boolean or None.

methods.name: get_secret( secret_name: str, default_value: Optional[Union[str, bool]] = None, )
methods.description: Fetches a secret from various sources, including environment variables, external secret managers, and OIDC providers, with multiple fallback options.

methods.name: bool _should_read_secret_from_secret_manager()
methods.description: Checks whether to read secrets from the secret manager based on client availability and access mode.
